attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3062/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The identity question is left open and no row of another folder is touched.** The corpus keeps `procopius-of-jerusalem, son of Theodosia` with a venerated Greek row on 8 July, and the historical reader of Scythopolis beheaded at Caesarea is often told as that man; but this is another day on the same calendar and another page, and the settled rule is that two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so two men. The page gives this one a profile of its own — a famous ascetic who was also a learned theologian and philosopher, a reader and preacher at Scythopolis, who answered the polytheists with a line of Homer — and names no emperor and no year. The reader's report names the question. No `dates` object is proposed, because the page gives no year. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
